caption:
Sticky needs a threshold. Without top (or bottom, left, right) it behaves like position: relative.

Sticky also sticks inside its nearest scrolling ancestor. If a parent has overflow: hidden, auto or scroll, the element sticks inside that parent instead of the page. Often it looks like it isn't working at all.

Debug fast: in DevTools, walk up the parents in the Elements panel and look for overflow in the Computed tab.

Source: MDN, position (sticky positioning).
